lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately five horizontal rows across the mid-flank, posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical alignments of spots creating a rectilinear grid pattern, most distinguishable in the central lateral region where vertical and horizontal axes meet.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition, with higher pixel intensity on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadowed gradient below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small cluster of discrete high-luminance blobs localized within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing lower density compared to the adjacent flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition in spot morphology from large discrete blobs on the flank to a high-frequency, dense field of micro-spots on the cephalic region.
